subject: Numeric literals
notes: LANDED 2026-08-18 (kb/Work PB99). 'shall include a decimal point' is the lexer's shape (a point-less 1E10 is a user-defined word, §8.3.1.1 — it is diagnosed as an undefined name, which it is); 'from 1 to 36 digits' is checked at the ONE normalizer both funnels share (COBOL1661 — a 40-digit significand); a 36-digit significand seeds a floating-point numeric-edited item exactly (the golden's E1).
